subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should Birdclaw adopt FxTwitter/FxEmbed as a first-class public-read transport in core, including configurable self-hosted endpoints?
rationale: The proposal fits the repository’s technical direction, but committing core configuration and UX to a third-party provider—and deciding the endpoint trust boundary—requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Approve narrow core MVP
options.body: Implement lookup, conversations, profile statuses, and search behind explicit opt-in with strict capability, privacy, URL-safety, persistence, and fixture-test boundaries.

options.title: Use fixed endpoint initially
options.body: Support the documented public service explicitly but defer arbitrary base URL overrides until the endpoint security policy is settled.

options.title: Defer provider adoption
options.body: Keep bird and xurl as the only core transports until provider stability, data handling, and long-term ownership are clearer.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow core MVP
recommendation.body: Implement lookup, conversations, profile statuses, and search behind explicit opt-in with strict capability, privacy, URL-safety, persistence, and fixture-test boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice changes the repository’s core transport portfolio and is governed by the product boundaries in VISION.md.
